blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water has advised consumers that it will conduct maintenance activities from October 14 to 17 in parts of Taguig, Marikina, Quezon City, and Rizal. “Manila Water is advising all residents of the affected areas to store enough water to supply their needs during the service improvement activity,” it added READ: Solon
